items.description: A comparison table of three plans with feature rows and yes/no cells; click a plan header to highlight its column.

items.title: Bottom Tab Bar
items.description: A phone-style navigation bar fixed to the bottom of the screen: icons with labels, a sliding highlight under the active tab, and arrow-key support.

items.title: Call-To-Action Band
items.description: A full-width banner with a short headline, one line of supporting text and a primary and a secondary button, placed above a footer.

items.title: Call-To-Action Footer
items.description: A closing section with a big headline, an email sign-up with inline validation, and a slim footer with link columns and a copyright line.

items.title: Centered Logo Header
items.description: A header with the logo in the middle, navigation links on both sides and a menu button that opens a full-width list on phones.

items.title: Contact Form With Validation
items.description: A contact form with name, email and message fields, inline error messages tied to each field, and a success message; it never sends anything until you add an address in the form action.

items.title: Cookie Notice Bar
items.description: A privacy notice fixed to the bottom of the page with Accept, Decline and a settings panel with an optional-cookies switch. The choice is remembered in the browser and the bar then stays away.

items.title: Feature Grid With Icons
items.description: A heading with six feature cards in a responsive grid, each with an icon, a title and a short description.

items.title: File Drop Zone
items.description: A drop area for files with a browse button, a size and type check, a list of the chosen files with remove buttons and live announcements. Files stay in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

items.title: Logo Cloud Grid
items.description: A "trusted by" strip with six client wordmarks in a quiet grid that gain colour on hover; drop in real logos by replacing the text marks.

items.title: Magnetic Call-To-Action Button
items.description: A large button that leans toward the pointer as it gets close, with a soft click ripple and a label that slides on hover. Touch and keyboard users get a plain, steady button.

items.title: Mega Menu Header
items.description: A header with a keyboard-accessible mega menu: hover or focus a top-level link to open a panel of grouped links with short descriptions; Escape closes it.

items.title: Minimal Credits Footer
items.description: A slim closing footer: a one-line sign-off, social links with icons, and a back-to-top button that appears after scrolling and respects reduced motion.

items.title: Multi-Step Form
items.description: A three-step form (about you, your project, review) with a progress bar, per-step validation, back and next buttons and a final summary. Keyboard friendly; nothing is sent.

items.title: Not Found (404) Page
items.description: A friendly 404 screen with a large status number, a short explanation, a button back home and a few useful links.

items.title: Pricing Table With Billing Switch

customizable.label: Plan 1 price per month when billed yearly
Plan 2 price per month when billed yearly
Plan 3 price per month when billed yearly

items.description: Three plain pricing cards with a monthly / yearly switch that updates the prices, a highlighted plan and a feature list per plan.

items.title: Search Bar With Suggestions
items.description: A search field with a suggestion list that filters as you type: arrow keys move through the options, Enter picks one, Escape closes. Built to the ARIA combobox pattern.

items.title: Search-First Header
items.description: A shop-style header with the logo, a wide search field, account and cart links, and a second row of category links that scrolls sideways on small screens.

items.title: Sign-In Card
items.description: A sign-in card with email and password, a show/hide password button, inline validation, a link to switch to creating an account and a forgot-password link. Nothing is sent anywhere.

items.title: Sitemap Footer With Newsletter Signup
items.description: A four-column sitemap footer with a newsletter form that validates the address, shows inline status messages and keeps the button disabled while sending.

items.title: Split Navigation With Announcement Bar
items.description: An editorial header: a dismissible announcement bar on top, links split left and right of a centred wordmark, and a thin rule underneath.

items.title: Stats Count-Up Row
items.description: A row of four big numbers that count up once when they scroll into view; with reduced motion the final numbers show immediately.

items.title: Sticky Shrinking Header
items.description: A header that sticks to the top, then shrinks and gains a frosted background after you scroll, with a call-to-action button and a mobile menu button.

items.title: Team Grid
items.description: A team section with four member cards: initials avatar, name, role and a profile link, in a grid that stacks on phones.

items.title: Toast Notification Stack
items.description: Stacked toast notifications that slide in, pause their timer on hover, dismiss on click or Escape, and are announced to screen readers. Buttons trigger success, info and error examples.

items.title: Toggle Switches And Segmented Control
items.description: Accessible form controls: animated on/off switches with a live status line and a segmented control (radio group) with a sliding thumb, all usable by keyboard.

items.title: About you, a short story
items.description: A short story about who you are: a poster-style shape, a heading, a paragraph and three facts with big numbers. Plain words, no animation, easy to rewrite.

items.title: Find us and opening hours
items.description: Where to find you: an address, a short note, a table of opening hours and a simple drawn map with a pin. Nothing is loaded from a map service, so it is fast and private; the button opens a map in a new page.

items.title: How we work, step by step
items.description: Your way of working in four numbered steps, each with a short title and one line. Plain, readable, no animation; steps stack on a phone.
